description: Before 1990, the citizens of Mississippi County faced a significant challenge: their state representative districts did not reflect the true demographics or needs of the community. This lack of fair representation meant many voices went unheard, especially in the most impoverished areas. The 1990 redistricting effort aimed to change that.A group of brave heroes and she-roes stepped forward to demand change. Lonnie Middlebrook Jr., Hattie Middlebrook, Reginald Robinson, Vicky Robinson, Albert Vea
title: The Fight for Fair Representation in Mississippi County
